title: Italian Pineapple Tart
description: A sweet and tangy Italian-inspired dessert featuring a flaky crust, caramelized pineapple, and a hint of adventurous spices.
instructions: Thaw the tart pastry dough and roll it out to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the dough in a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Crumble the dough into the pan, pressing it into the corners and up the sides.
Prick the bottom of the crust with a fork to prevent it from bubbling during baking.
Line the crust with parchment paper and fill with pie weights or dried beans.
Bake the crust for 15 minutes, then remove the parchment paper and pie weights or beans.
Caramelize the pineapple by heating a tablespoon of coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the pineapple to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until it starts to caramelize.
Spread the caramelized pineapple evenly over the baked tart crust.
Sprinkle the adventurous spice blend and a drizzle of maple syrup over the pineapple.
Bake the tart for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Allow the tart to cool completely before dusting with powdered sugar and garnishing with fresh mint leaves.
